confirmed.martialPool: Existing native pool, reset at actual own turn start in combat; explicit new-turn confirmation outside combat. No action economy automation.
confirmed.chakraEnhancedStrikes: At most two benefits per cast; up to two extra unarmed dice; ignore half DR at most once.
confirmed.rawTechnique: After one defense calculation subtract full damage from normal HP and also temporary HP; no second overflow to HP.
confirmed.brutalTechnique: Replace existing ability contribution with STR+DEX; without original modifier add ceil half Taijutsu ability modifier.
confirmed.guardSlots: Use existing actual armor seal profiles, persistent choice after confirmed Full Rest; only when actual Martial Defense AC calculation is used.
confirmed.guardSlotCosts: Native occupancy: Minor1, Refined2, Greater3, Superior4; duplicate base seal not allowed.
confirmed.conditionalBypass: Confirm specific actual penalties/defense effects for Furious/Precise; do not remove all defenses.
confirmed.frenzyDie: Roll separately for each eligible hit.
confirmed.frenzyEarlyEnd: Any hostile attack/forced save OR taking damage suffices.
confirmed.devastatingDamage: One already applied original hit and original target selected per cast; floor half actual damage on failed DEX save, zero on success.
confirmed.furiousAttacks: At most two additional attacks, two Martial Dice each; original jutsu requires at least two attacks.
confirmed.precisePenalties: Remove explicitly confirmed numeric penalties only; disadvantage remains.
confirmed.savageForce: Next damaging melee attack bypasses DR, resistance and other reductions; immunity and normal temporary HP absorption remain. Reaction prohibition displayed, action economy manual.
confirmed.devastatingMixedDamage: Confirm actual post-defense typed damage shares and their halved allocation; total must equal floor half actual original hit damage.
confirmed.tyrantsStacking: Multiple paid bonuses against the same original creature add and are consumed together by the next confirmed damaging hit.
confirmed.flurryGuards: Literal source: damage reduction always one Martial Die; attack reduction up to two at level7/three at level13.
confirmed.focusedTechnique: Each point of failed CON save causes2d12 damage and1 Weakened rank; actual damage type explicitly confirmed, including otherwise damage-less jutsu.
confirmed.talentKeywords: Count keywords granted by paid Martial Techniques including Talent, Focus and Technical themselves; general jutsu keywords such as Combo excluded.
confirmed.shatterpointMode: Choose temporary HP loss OR explicitly confirmed DR effects; not both.
confirmed.shatterpointRecovery: Temporary HP are lost permanently. Selected DR effects remain stored and are suppressed only until next target turn start.
confirmed.shatterpointTiming: On failed STR save, remove temporary HP or suppress selected DR effects before the triggering hit damage.
confirmed.redirectedAggression: Choose actual missed original attack and caster, pay1 Martial Die, native unarmed counter with original melee/ranged range. Confirm hit and store GM application of actual original damage/effects, no new cast or Chakra payment. Critical counter makes reflected damage critical.
confirmed.mightyGuards: Floor half proficiency until level14, full proficiency thereafter; HP damage including Psychic, Chakra excluded, one shared budget per damage application.
confirmed.flamingFinisherRank: Pay chosen original rank; effect one rank higher up to S, upkeep uses higher effective rank. S and d12 are upper bounds; higher paid benefits remain available.
confirmed.dynamicSetupRestriction: After the confirmed jutsu pair block action/bonus-action Taijutsu until next own turn start; reaction casts allowed, action economy otherwise manual.
confirmed.unbreakableWill: Consumes one Martial Die normally; Matrix Freedom from the Machine may waive this payment. Installed Unshakeable Will reference interpreted as Unbreakable Will by explicit user confirmation.
confirmed.matrixFreedomPool: Shared WIS-modifier allowance for free Unbreakable Will and Master of Persistence; resets on recipient long/full rest.
confirmed.remainingTaijutsuRounding: For remaining unimplemented Taijutsu rules, round unspecified halves up. Preserve already explicitly confirmed exceptions, including half-DR and Mighty Guards.
confirmed.enhancedBlowsScope: First two confirmed successful attacks of exactly one declared Attack action or one Taijutsu cast. Not a pool carried into later actions/casts.
confirmed.unstableCoreTargets: After both attacks, one STR save per actually hit creature, even when both hit the same creature.
confirmed.disturbanceFlurryVariants: Normal and level17 Finisher variant share one once-per-turn limit. Choose one. Base3 Dice reduced to2 by actually owned Disturbing Endurance.
confirmed.barrageTiming: Vulnerability starts after complete damage of both triggering hits, for next separate damage of selected type.
confirmed.disturbingDistribution: As evenly as possible; per-target attack counts differ by at most one. Example4 attacks/3 enemies =>2/1/1.
confirmed.stanceBlendingAttack: Each matching attack rolls one Martial Die, halves result and rounds up.
confirmed.dodgeCancel: Roll once at activation; store penalty for first matching attack each turn.
confirmed.damageInterception: Reduce original pre-defense damage by confirmed feature bonus, then apply only protector defenses.
confirmed.stancerScope: Automate known stance activation, simultaneous stances, costs, duration and class bonuses. Underlying existing stance abilities remain manual by explicit agreement.
confirmed.stancerUnlocks: Owned installed stance profiles only; record explicit class learning choices without duplicating existing items.
confirmed.stancerCostIncreases: Ignore imposed Shocked, Void, Disruption, Persistent and cost Fracture increases. Voluntary extras and molding prices remain payable.
confirmed.stancerSurchargeConsumption: Successful cast still consumes ignored next-jutsu Void/Chakra Disruption surcharge.
confirmed.galeDuration: Paid dash AC bonus lasts until next own turn start.
confirmed.cycloneFlurry: Cyclone grants free Flurry after actual Attack Action even if not separately learned as a Martial Technique.
confirmed.elementalArmorDuration: No fixed maximum duration; pay one Martial Die at each own turn start until explicitly ended. Action economy remains manual.
confirmed.elementalArmorUpkeep: Automatically pay one Martial Die after native own-turn pool recovery in the same batch; end enhanced form when unavailable. Outside combat explicitly confirm own turn.
confirmed.catalystShortCircuit: Actual stored Incapacitated/Stunned states trigger short circuit; additional explicit manual confirmation for unstructured conditions. Unbreakable Catalyst prevents this.
confirmed.quarterstaffStrength: Double original Unarmed base dice count, e.g.1d8 to2d8; retain extra dice.
confirmed.grappleChecks: Explicitly confirm an already actually successful grapple; do not invent opposed check rules.
confirmed.ultraRepeatCost: Repeated activation before rest costs both2 Martial Dice and5 Chakra Dice.
confirmed.nunchakuFuryCritical: Exactly1d6 even on critical hits; no augmentation.
confirmed.chainGrab: Resolve sequentially; second technique replaces first ongoing effect, previously dealt damage remains.
confirmed.mysticAwakeningUse: Consumes only its own separate native use, not ordinary Ultra Instinct use.
confirmed.mysticFinisher: Add one original damage die and1 save DC.
confirmed.submissionEscape: Successful escape ends only all conditions and ongoing damage granted by that specific submission; unrelated effects remain.
confirmed.tonfaTrip: Roll Martial Die bonus, then explicitly confirm actual external Trip comparison; do not invent opposed-check rules.
confirmed.lightningWrathInterception: Split original raw damage first: ceil half to original target. Only remaining protector share receives interception feature reduction then protector defenses.
confirmed.sereneRepeatSaveBlock: On actual hostile target turn start/end within10 feet: no repeat saves ending Jutsu Charm/Fear until next target own turn start.
confirmed.identicalTaijutsuStacking: Strongest same-ability value; renew duration on renewed activation. Different abilities remain separate.
confirmed.lightningWrathArea: Original target makes its normal actual Save against the direct share. Automatic Iron Heart protection covers only redirected share.
confirmed.windPhysics: Bind confirmed concrete Wind Cloak/Wrath immunity and state;10-foot clear zone, token movement and map traps remain manual. No broad unverified deletion or retroactive HP rollback.
confirmed.thereIsNoChakra: Native concentration DC10 minus Martial Die; failure ends only explicitly selected effects of exact benefiting Jutsu, including non-concentration Jutsu.
confirmed.oppressiveAuraRepeat: Repeat Constitution save at affected target turn end.
confirmed.specialCastHalves: Oppressive Aura and Instinctual Inversion: ceil half unmodified selected rank price before allowed discounts; foreign surcharges last. Optional Aura3 Chakra separate extra.
confirmed.inversionOrder: Defense roll reduces original area damage before own defenses; at100% save advantage, at150% automatic save success. Map/protected space manual.
confirmed.shieldBashDamage: Confirmed actual successful Shove: original Unarmed hit plus Martial Die, one combined damage application, Bruised. No second full Unarmed damage.
confirmed.quarterstaffExpertDefenses: Bypass DR/resistance/other reductions; retain immunities and consume temporary HP normally, as confirmed by user.
confirmed.leviathanDamage: Actual ally Unarmed damage plus source Martial Die; source attack bonus. Movement and weapon handoff confirmed manually.
